notes:
コピー{用紙|ようし} is standard white paper used in photocopiers and printers. An everyday office and school supply.

COMMON SIZES IN JAPAN:
- A4 (210×297mm): most common office standard
- B5 (182×257mm): common in schools (Japan uses the JIS B-series)
- A3 (297×420mm): for larger documents and posters

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- コピー{用紙|ようし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: ran out of copy paper
- コピー{用紙|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補充|ほじゅう}する→補充する：25240_hojuusuru⟧: to refill/restock paper
- コピー{用紙|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to load paper (into a printer)

RELATED WORDS:
- {上質紙|じょうしつし}: high-quality paper
- ⟦{再生紙|さいせいし}→再生紙：22826_saiseishi⟧: recycled paper
- ⟦{裏紙|うらがみ}→裏紙：08068_uragami⟧: scrap paper (reusing the blank back side of printed paper)
